what.title: What Is PDF Unlocking?
what.content: PDF unlocking removes password restrictions or access protections from PDF documents when {strong} are available. This grants permitted access to owned files that were previously restricted. Once unlocked, you can permanently secure the raw file in our {link}.

options.title: Supported Restrictions
options.subtitle: We safely remove these restrictions when the master password is provided:
options.note: Permission-only restrictions can be removed without a password.

modern.title: Modern PDF Encryption Support
modern.content: We natively support unlocking AES-encrypted PDFs, password-protected documents, and permission-based restrictions using highly optimized secure browser decryption workflows. All decryption is performed completely client-side.

items.q: Are PDF files uploaded to servers?
items.a: No. All PDF processing happens locally inside your browser.
